verdict.rationale: Slack ships first-party AI features that generate insights directly from workspace data: an intelligent daily briefing, an AI agent (Slackbot) that summarizes reports/channels/threads, cross-source search over integrated content (Drive, Salesforce, etc.), meeting-note generation, translation, and Claude-powered Q&A — all inside the product surface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evaluation of the quality or accuracy of these AI-generated insights, and no community evidence specifically corroborating (or disputing) how well the AI summarization/briefing features work in practice.
